_warning: Angles are relative to the encoder zero of the session in which they were measured. Encoders reset on power-on, so these are only valid across reboots once the arm is homed to a repeatable zero.
reference: folded end of each joint, set with jog.py 'z'

3.note: zero = folded end (park pose); no margin at 0 so park can reach it

2.note: zero = folded end (park pose). Max is a deliberate cap, not the mechanical end: beyond it certain J2/J3 combinations collide.

4.note: No mechanical stop -- J4 turns freely (~360 deg explored, arm never resisted). +/-179 is a chosen cap, protecting the wiring run to the hand from winding up, not a physical limit.

_park_is_origin: Joints flagged park_is_origin are parked AT their zero before power-down (park.py). A reading near 0 at connect is consistent with that but does not prove it -- the encoder reads 0 at power-on wherever the arm is -- so measured limits are enforced only after the joint is zeroed (home.py, jog.py 'z') or an operator who has looked at the arm calls confirm_parked() (button in teleop_gui.py).
